title: This Magical Girl is a B☆tch
description:
⭐️DA-DA-DA-DADA!⭐️ 

BULLIES OF MIDDLING MIDDLE SCHOOL, YOU'RE IN FOR A SURPRISE!  

It's Halloween Spirit Week and even gloomy Tabbie is ready for some fun.  

But when her nemesis, Eden, (the WORST kind of eighth grade boy), steals her thunder, everything goes horribly wrong. 

Luckily, a magical pixie comes to Tabbie's aid and grants her the power WHACK THE SH⭐️T out of anyone in her way!  

 While her tiny handler expects her to use her new powers for good, this magical girl has other plans in mind: ⭐️ REVENGE!!! ⭐️  

*********************************************************************************

This Magical Girl is a B⭐️tch is a comedic visual novel inspired by magical girl staples such as Shugo Chara and Card Captor Sakura.  

       

⭐️ UNCONVENTIONAL MAGICAL GIRL: Tabbie Bones' magical misadventures thus far, detailed in 24k words, 15 CGs, and 2 animated transformation sequences (~3 hours of playtime)

⭐️ FULLY VOICED CAST: Every student and faculty member of Middling Middle School has a voice (and they're going to use it!)

⭐️ BRANCHING CHOICES, STICKER ACHIEVEMENTS, SECRET ENDINGS: Actions have consequences...especially when you're a magical girl!

⭐️ EXPRESSIVE CHARACTER SPRITES: 200+ hand-drawn expressions and poses meticulously coded to dance across the screen at your command.

⭐️ORIGINAL EARWORMS: Catchy original soundtrack to accompany Tabbie's saddest, maddest, and baddest moments.
*Full game statistics will be available at launch 

           

          

⭐ VOICE TALENT ⭐️ 

Abby Pasion as Tabbie 

Noah Belachew as Eden 

Victor Melin as Calem and Tonathan 

Jacob "Zombie_J" Mira as Mr. Teacher and Mr. Monster 

Taylor Fernandez as Strength and Clown

Robin van der Niet as Love 

Ali Gohar as Magician 

Nyima Green as Stu 

Eden Solomon as Den 

Corey LeVier as PA Guy and Sad PA Guy 

Joyce Liu as Corpse 

Shelley Hunter as Doll and ???
description_short: A magical girl visual novel about giving middle-schoolers way too much power. Make (bad) choices, fight unexpected enemies, and maybe learn a lesson or two...
